name: DirectCart Enquiries for WooCommerce
author: mohammed91ayman

sections.description:
DirectCart Enquiries for WooCommerce adds a configurable WhatsApp enquiry button beneath the add-to-cart form on WooCommerce product pages.

The generated message can include the product name, displayed price, product URL and SKU. The plugin stores no visitor messages and adds no analytics.

Features:

  • Configurable WhatsApp number and button label.
  • Message template placeholders for product name, price, URL and SKU.
  • Custom button color.
  • Optional new-tab behavior.
  • Keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
  • No visitor data storage or hidden tracking.

Documentation, support and feedback

  • Product information
  • Installation and troubleshooting documentation
  • Ask for support or share feedback
  • Arabic documentation
  • Arabic support and feedback

The website support form prepares a message for your email app or WhatsApp. You review and send the message yourself; the website form does not store it on the website server. No paid-service purchase is required to ask for help with this free plugin. Do not include passwords, license keys, payment details or customer information.

You can also ask questions in the public WordPress.org support forum. Do not post sensitive information publicly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open WooCommerce > DirectCart Enquiries.
  4. Add the WhatsApp number with country code, without spaces or the plus sign.
  5. Review the message template and save.
sections.faq:
Does it send orders automatically?

No. It opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled product enquiry. The visitor reviews and sends the message.

Does it store customer messages?

No. The plugin creates the WhatsApp link on the product page and does not store message content.

Which placeholders are supported?

Use {product_name}, {price}, {product_url} and {sku} in the message template.
